jobs.title: Sales Representative Medical Aesthetic Products
jobs.description: Healthspan Global is seeking a B2B Medical Sales Representative who will be a key player in the company's business and sales growth in the assigned area (North Luzon). As a Medical Sales Representative, you will be a master of our skincare product line and communicate these to a wide array of dermatologists, healthcare physicians, or clinics for demonstrations, presentations, and repeated sales. You will be connecting with target clients and businesses in order to establish a customer network and engage with them through multiple selling channels. You will also stay up-to-date on dermatological products and the overall wellness market with continuous learning and training. Key Responsibilities: Identifying and penetrating new accounts within your area and executing product demos, presentations, and activities with doctors Maintaining key client relationships with doctors and stakeholders to ensure continued sales and wholesale distribution Planning and strategizing area itinerary to maximize coverage Product management and training

jobs.title: Customer Sales Associate, SM Seaside Cebu
jobs.description: We are looking for a Customer Sales Associate to provide attentive, knowledgeable, and personalized customer service. This is position will be reporting to work at SM Seaside Cebu. You will report directly to the Store Supervisor. Key responsibilities: Customer Engagement and Service Delivery Welcome and acknowledge customers in a warm, respectful, and professional manner. Observe customer behaviour and offer assistance at an appropriate time without creating unnecessary pressure Understand customer needs through relevant questions and active listening. Assist customers in identifying suitable products based on preferences, occasion, size, and availability. Maintain a helpful and respectful approach throughout the customer journey. Handle routine customer inquiries and refer concerns requiring authorization to the Store Head. Product Knowledge and Merchandise Assistance Maintain working knowledge of current collections, product categories, sizes, styles, features, and available merchandise. Explain product information accurately and avoid unsupported claims. Recommend appropriate complementary products when relevant to customer needs. Assist with product selection, fitting-room requirements, alternative sizes, and styling options. Maintain appropriate customer privacy, comfort, and professional boundaries. Sales Productivity Contribute to the achievements of store sales targets through effective customer assistance. Apply customer engagement techniques that support conversion, ATV, UPT, and other approved KPIs. Participate in daily sales briefings and understand assigned productivity objectives. Respond constructively to coaching and implement agreed improvements. Balance sales productivity with the brand’s non-hard-selling service philosophy. Selling-Floor and Merchandise Standards Maintain cleanliness, orderliness, and presentation of assigned selling areas. Replenish merchandise and maintain correct product placements, size arrangement, and display standards. Ens

jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description: Your Impact Areas 1. Achieve Sales Revenue Targets Lead the team to meet or exceed overall sales goals. Track sales performance and implement actions to close gaps. 2. Improve Opportunity-to-Win Conversion Rates Guide the team in effective prospecting, qualification, and deal closing. Monitor pipeline health and address obstacles impacting conversion. 3. Manage Individual and Team Quota Attainment Set clear quotas and review performance regularly. Provide coaching and support to ensure consistent achievement. 4. Develop and Execute Strategic Sales Plans Create and refine strategies based on data, customer insights, and market trends. Align team initiatives with core KPIs and organizational priorities. 5. Strengthen Customer Relationships Maintain high customer satisfaction and identify growth opportunities. Support the team in upselling, cross-selling, and retention efforts. 6. Coach and Develop the Sales Team Deliver ongoing training, mentoring, and performance feedback. Build a high-performance culture focused on continuous improvement. 7. Analyze Sales Data for Decision-Making Track KPIs such as revenue achievement, conversion rates, and quotas. Report insights that guide strategic and operational adjustments. 8. Collaborate Across Departments Work with marketing, operations, and other teams to support sales initiatives. Share market and customer feedback for product and service enhancement.
